race.title: Betfair Supports Safer Gambling Week Newton Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: COSMIC CONNECTION looks well worth another chance to build on his promising novice season. He gets the nod over North Shore and Saint Jeannais , who have both created favourable impressions, while Spanish Darling and Hold The Throw could outrun their forecast odds under speed-favouring conditions. COSMIC CONNECTION (IRE) NORTH SHORE (FR) SAINT JEANNAIS (FR)
